rightsBinding.shareAlikeScope: Only this OSM-derived transfer topology fact/edge if distributed as part of a derived database; provide attribution and make that derived database available under ODbL 1.0. This does not apply to unrelated network records.

components.name: 菜園場町
components.operator: とさでん交通株式会社

gtfsIdentity.currentPassengerAccessReview: Current operator opposite public-road components plus independently explicit pedestrian crossing-side instruction and actual OSM traffic-signal/zebra/sidewalk chain support coarse passenger-component relation. No coordinate proximity/snapping, exact curb/pole/door, accessibility, travel time or hotel node. JEA does not narrate every selected way. Personally viewed2026map: separate south-side alight and north-side airport boarding markers along tram street; exact current GTFS retains both records and directions. Personally rendered/viewed JEA organizer2025-02-10 guide: airportbound Saenbacho lies across tram street from Karupoto; walk east from venue. Historical walking-side corroboration only, never treated as2026 timetable/version. Current SouthBreeze hotel own access independently distinguishes airport bus Saenba alight/walk from tram Saenba walk; OMO7 own current access also names airportbus Saenbacho walk. Neither claims a crossing; no private hotel traversal used.
